profile.headline: Software Engineer II at Wealthfront
profile.summary:
Front End: JavaScript (ES6+), React, jQuery, Babel / Webpack, Jest / Enzyme,  HTML5, CSS, Redux, Next.js, framer-motion
Back-end: MySQL, MongoDB, Node.js, Express, PostgreSQL
Deployment/Testing: Docker, AWS (EC2) , New Relic, Jest/Enzyme, Mocha/Chai

I'm a full stack software engineer who likes the challenge solving complex problems and developing tools to make life better, less stressful and convenient! 

I am extremely hardworking and perseverant, with a passion to excel. I have people skills that were developed through my life experiences. I am a team oriented person, as I always look forward to meeting new people and working with them. I have the attitude to seek success in my life. "I want this for myself". I am outgoing and down to earth. I learn quickly and I am proactive.

Check out some of my personal projects: https://github.com/Ochaart
Check out my personal portfolio (work in progress) : https://mjhperez-portfolio.vercel.app/

positions.title: Front End Software Engineer - Personal Portfolio
positions.description:
- Built in Next.js 
- Integrated intersection observers to initiate Framer-Motion animations
- Applied Framer-Motion animations API 

I challenged myself to build my portfolio using new technologies such as Next.js, intersection observer API and Framer-Motion and I had a blast. Currently compatible with desktop 16inch full-screen and some mobile devices. Work in progress.

positions.title: Front End Software Engineer -- Social Media and Web Application for Stitching and Knitting Community
positions.description:
- Built the user page interface which displayed up to 5 vertical carousels representing created, purchased, favorited, in progress and completed patterns.
- Created optimized experience for new and existing users integrating backend Authentication service and ContextAPI to conditionally render logged in and non-logged in landing pages.
- Increased API performance by debouncing client interactions on frequently used elements.
- Dynamically rendered pop-up modal at desired location based on click event clientX and clientY and factoring in scrolling offset.

positions.title: Full Stack Software Engineer -- LazyChef
positions.description:
I love to cook so I created a simple application in less than 2 days where I can easily search for recipes and save them on a cookbook. But! Let's be honest some days you just want to treat yourself to a nice meal so I created a second search option for restaurants in SF :)

- Integrated Yelp API and Spoonacular Api
- Navigation Bar using React-Router-Dom for single page rendering
- Mongoose and MongoDB to store recipes
- Styled-Components for design
- Implemented pop-up modals to display restaurant and recipe details
- Restaurant photo carousel with dot navigation.

positions.title: Back End Software Engineer -- Back-end API for eCommerce Product API
positions.description:
- Scaled and designed multi-layer backend system from 500 to 4,000 rps for 1 min or 0 - 10,000 rps for 20 seconds using load balancing through NGINX with 0% error.
- Optimized query design in SQL via joins and subqueries to reduce database response time from 30ms to 4ms.
- Containerized services with Docker to deploy server and database across multiple AWS ec2 micro instances.
- Performed ETL using Node.js, javascript and MySql to validate and load over 60 million rows of CSV data.

positions.title: Full Stack Engineer - eCommerce Related Items & Outfits Section
positions.description:
- Architected a React front-end service supported by a RESTful API back-end, implementing three photo carousels and pop-up modal.
- Created seamless user experience through dynamic client-side routing using React Router that empowered users to browse through all retail items served by product API server
- Wrote and performed tests using Enzyme and Jest
- Designed with styled-components, key-frames, and media queries.
- Implemented scroll animations with useLayoutEffect, useRef and JavaScript
- Dynamically rendered star rating from backend Reviews API
- Dynamically rendered carousel buttons on screen resizing
- Created navigation bar that allows users to quickly traverse collections. Tracks scrollLeft position and updates css when using carousel buttons.
- Implemented server-side caching and client side local storage to allow clients to save and retain outfits added to their collection.

positions.title: Sales Manager
positions.description: Responsible for meeting sales targets, mapping potential customers, generating leads for the organization, maintaining and improving relationships with clients.

positions.title: Front Desk Agent / Cultural Ambassador
positions.description: Responsible for all front desk duties. Trained in all areas from AM, PM and night audit	shifts. Handled rooms, reservations, guest services, maintenance, marketing, employee relations, invoices, travel agent checks, philanthropic partners, and social media. Helped out in other supervisor duties, events, training new employees, F&B, purchasing, revenues, operations, business plans, and product designs.

positions.title: Admistrative Assistant Intern
positions.description: Trained under the Director of I-SPA at Intercontinental San Francisco. Worked as the director’s personal assistant, I-SPA concierge, and marketing assistant. Work load ranged from marketing, front desk, event host, public relations and networking.

positions.title: Student Intern
positions.description: Trained under the Marketing, F&B, and Front office department. Worked as a front desk student associate, business center student associate, marketing student associate, human resources student associate and as a supervisor, bartender and waiter under the F&B department.
